source: Standalone template for the 'Object with Reference Décor Generator' capability — composites a décor/design reference photo onto a real, already-finished object reference photo (no branding/logo-swap pass, unlike capabilities #1-#3). Independently maintained from presets.v1.json / presets-simple.v1.json. Reuses the validated prompt language from the balloon-decor pilot (snacket-website/balloons pages, gen-balloon-ev-pilot.mjs, deleted standalone script) — see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-06-ev-decor-reference-generator.md.
global_rules_text: CRITICAL — NO LABEL TEXT: "IMAGE A" and "IMAGE B" are internal reference labels for this prompt only. NEVER render the literal words "IMAGE A" or "IMAGE B" as text anywhere in the output.
